ops.title: v0.43.1 fixed TUI re-login probing the Keychain with empty service fields; needs-login liveness is proven ONLY by a forced refresh, never a usage-API 200

ops.body:
2026-07-05 incident (acct-09): `a` on the ccp status TUI ran a successful `claude /login` but
"never detected it" and errored `keychain item not found`. Root cause: `daemon.AccountStatus`
carries no keychain fields; `fromDaemon` built a partial `store.Account`, so the re-login probe
ran `security find-generic-password -a "" -s ""`. Fixed in **cc-pool v0.43.1**: the TUI re-loads
the account via `Store.GetAccount` inside `startReloginCmd` before any credential op.

Durable design rules from the review (adversarial gpt-5.5 refuter REFUTED the first design):

- **A usage-API 200 (or 429) does NOT prove a credential's refresh chain** — the daemon flags
  needs-login on *proactive* refresh failure while the access token may have hours of life, and
  cc-pool never blanks a dead refresh token on disk. The only sound liveness proof is a forced
  refresh via `EnsureFreshToken(ctx, a, forcedRefreshHorizon /* MaxInt64 */, true)` — the
  daemon-proven lock→refresh→atomic-persist path. Never hand-roll rotate+store (single-use
  refresh tokens; see [[creds-fresher-wins-decision]]).
- Wire snapshots are display-only; any credential operation must re-load the account from the
  store (comment pinned in `fromDaemon`).
- `ccp login N` / TUI `a` short-circuit ONLY when the store flags needs-login; on rate-limited/
  stale/unflagged accounts a login always runs (user may be switching subscriptions).
- No `AdoptRotatedToken` after our own refresh — our `writeCred` already owns the ACL; adoption
  is only for claude-written (`/login`) credentials.
- **v0.43.2** closed the baseline gap: `finishRelogin` (and its grace probe `awaitFreshCred`)
  now requires the credential to DIFFER from the pre-login baseline token — quit-without-login
  fails closed instead of clearing a correct flag. The grace probe had to be baseline-aware
  too, or the stale-but-usable pre-login cred would satisfy it instantly.
- Known-not-fixed: needs-login clear has a narrow TOCTOU vs a concurrent daemon
  `SetNeedsLogin` (self-heals via fresher-wins next poll) — durable backlog task 3e25d58
  (flag-generation / compare-and-swap in the store).
